def digits(n: int) -> int:
    """Return the product of the odd digits of a positive integer n.
    If n contains no odd digits, return 0.
    """
    product = 1
    found_odd = False
    while n:
        digit = n % 10
        if digit % 2:
            product *= digit
            found_odd = True
        n //= 10
    return product if found_odd else 0
